show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Marc Lasry - Making Bucks in Credit and Sports - [Invest Like the Best, EP.371]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Marc is a pioneer of distressed debt investing and the CEO of Avenue Capital Group.
reader_summary.overview: Marc is a pioneer of distressed debt investing and the CEO of Avenue Capital Group, which he co-founded with his sister in 1995. More recently, Marc and Avenue have become active investors in sport. He owned the Milwaukee Bucks when they won the NBA championship in 2021, and has since made investments in sports as diverse as sailing and bull-riding.

key_points.text: In our discussion, we talk about his journey building a big investing firm, the evolution of distressed investing, and the opportunities in sport today.
Marc shares some great stories throughout about travelling with President Clinton, winning the NBA championship, and raising his first fund.
Please enjoy this great conversation with Marc Lasry.
